_comment: Shared decode test vectors for the Rust step_encoding and TS ifc-string decoders. Expected values use JSON unicode escapes so this file stays pure ASCII. Both decoders must agree on every case.

cases.name: doubled_backslash_is_one
cases._comment: ISO 10303-21 doubles the reverse solidus inside a string literal exactly as it doubles the apostrophe.

cases.name: escaped_directive_text_is_literal
cases._comment: Every backslash is doubled, so this is the literal characters \X2\00FC\X0\ and NOT a U+00FC directive.

cases.name: directive_then_escaped_backslash
cases._comment: The directive consumes its own \X0\ terminator first, so the trailing pair is one literal backslash. Three consecutive backslashes; a split-at-every-pair decoder eats the terminator here.

cases.name: s_escape_operand_is_backslash
cases._comment: \S\ takes the NEXT character as its operand, so the backslash there is an operand and not half of a pair: 0x5C + 128 = U+00DC.

cases.name: empty_x_payload_pair_collapses
cases._comment: Malformed: an empty \X2\ payload rejects the directive, the scan resumes one character in, and the pair it lands on is a valid escaped reverse solidus. Pins that both decoders make the same reading of the leftover.

cases.name: s_escape_non_bmp_parity
cases._comment: Malformed: \S\ is spec-defined for ASCII only. Pins that both decoders read the whole code point (U+1F600) plus 128 (=U+1F680) and advance past the surrogate pair, rather than diverging on a trailing surrogate.
